2026-09-05-aml-paradigm-news.title: Is Stronger Chemotherapy Always Better for Leukemia?
2026-09-05-aml-paradigm-news.description: Read the PARADIGM trial from bone marrow biology and drug action through treatment groups, event-free survival, hazard ratios, infections, and bleeding. Figures and worked examples clarify which patients the findings may apply to.

2026-09-05-gpt-6-astra-safety-news.title: Are More Capable AI Systems Safer and Easier to Monitor?
2026-09-05-gpt-6-astra-safety-news.description: Original graphs from the GPT-6 Astra safety report illustrate prompt injection, monitorability, and control over reasoning. Worked examples distinguish attack attempts and success rates from model and monitor performance.

2026-09-07-dlcatalysis-neuac-news.title: Can AI-Selected Enzymes Improve Industrial Fermentation?
2026-09-07-dlcatalysis-neuac-news.description: A NeuAc production study connects AI-assisted enzyme design with metabolic regulation in a microbial strain. Concentration, productivity, and yield help assess how protein changes contributed to fermentation results.

2026-09-07-glud1-hsc-news.title: A 500-Fold Increase in Stem Cells: What Still Functions?
2026-09-07-glud1-hsc-news.description: A mouse study examines how Glud1 inhibition affects blood stem cell self-renewal. Cell counts, expansion in culture, and transplantation assays measure different outcomes and leave questions about use in humans.

2026-09-07-openai-research-automation-fr.title: AI Research Interns: What Does 3.1 Days Measure?
2026-09-07-openai-research-automation-fr.description: Read OpenAI’s research automation data through its original diagrams and equations. The analysis covers agent roles, runtime, productivity, limits to parallel work, human intervention, and the denominator behind success rates.

2026-09-08-carep-news.title: Keeping CAR-T Cells in Culture for 100 Days
2026-09-08-carep-news.description: CAREp arranges antigen and costimulatory signals outside CAR-T cells. Culture duration and cumulative expansion provide a starting point for interpreting cell function, metabolism, and the separate question of clinical benefit.

2026-09-09-navier-stokes-openai-frontier.title: Navier–Stokes: From Vortex Images to Equations
2026-09-09-navier-stokes-openai-frontier.description: Follow the terms of the equations, the energy balance, and the contraction rates in the original figures. Coordinates and velocity formulas from the formalization clarify the difference between an order estimate and a complete proof.

2026-09-15-apoe-stratified-alzheimer-new.title: Rereading the Genetics of Alzheimer’s Disease by APOE Variant
2026-09-15-apoe-stratified-alzheimer-new.description: A large genetic study splits results by APOE ε2, ε3, and ε4. Sample sizes, statistical significance, the DDHD1 association, and Korean data help define the limits of interpretation for treatment.

2026-09-15-mspa-fpba-nanopore-news.title: One Nanopore Distinguishes 40 Biomolecules
2026-09-15-mspa-fpba-nanopore-news.description: Current through a small protein pore distinguishes amino acids, sugars, nucleotides, and short peptides. The original data explain the 98.7% and 96.7% results and the distance from classification to full sequencing.

2026-09-16-oect-swelling-mapping-news.title: Where Does a Wet Semiconductor Swell and Fail?
2026-09-16-oect-swelling-mapping-news.description: An organic electrochemical transistor carries ions and electrons. Measurements during operation reveal swelling and show how laser methods, spatial and temporal resolution, 15 million switching cycles, and a 15-day experiment constrain the conclusions.

2026-09-16-onprem-medical-agent-news.title: When Should Medical AI Hand a Case to a Clinician?
2026-09-16-onprem-medical-agent-news.description: A Nature Medicine study assesses a medical AI system run inside a hospital. Consistency across repeated answers guides case selection. The denominators behind 49.4% and 98.9% clarify what external evaluation can establish before clinical use.

2026-09-17-adolescent-hemophilia-b-news.title: One Gene Therapy for Adolescents with Hemophilia B
2026-09-17-adolescent-hemophilia-b-news.description: A phase 1 study of AAV gene therapy in 11 adolescents examines factor IX, the Padua variant, 52-week activity, and bleeding rates. Immunosuppression and adverse events help frame the long-term safety questions in this single-arm trial.

2026-09-17-ms-ebv-prerelapse-news.title: What Does an EBV Signal in Blood Mean Before an MS Relapse?
2026-09-17-ms-ebv-prerelapse-news.description: EBV-related immune signals appeared up to three months before multiple sclerosis relapses. Data from 240 samples across 135 people illustrate the RNA and protein assays, and the work needed to establish causation or predict relapses.

2026-09-18-delphy-outbreak-phylogenetics.title: Delphy Speeds Up Outbreak Phylogenetics with Sparse Mutations
2026-09-18-delphy-outbreak-phylogenetics.description: Delphy’s mutation-annotated trees reduce repeated work across similar pathogen sequences. Outbreak datasets and a 100,000-sequence experiment illustrate Bayesian inference, convergence, and uncertainty in dates.

2026-09-18-panxeon-pancreatic-liquid-bio.title: PANXEON: What Does 86.8% Mean for a Pancreatic Cancer Blood Test?
2026-09-18-panxeon-pancreatic-liquid-bio.description: PANXEON combines ten microRNAs with CA19-9. The denominators for sensitivity, false-positive rate, and positive predictive value clarify what diagnostic performance can tell us about a future screening program.

2026-09-18-paper2agent-news.title: Turning a Research Paper into an Executable AI Agent
2026-09-18-paper2agent-news.description: Compare AlphaGenome, paper-specific agents, and the general-purpose Biomni agent. The Paper2Agent workflow and its Scanpy example connect tool preparation and validation with benchmark scale and cost.

2026-09-19-anthropic-wet-lab-mhs-news.title: Why Anthropic Built a Wet Lab
2026-09-19-anthropic-wet-lab-mhs-news.description: Explore Anthropic’s laboratory and Genentech’s MHS experiment, the roles of Claude Science, MCP, and instrument drivers, and what a closed-loop run and a foaming failure reveal about validation.

2026-09-19-dual-neural-progenitors-news.title: When Do the Front and Back of the Brain Diverge?
2026-09-19-dual-neural-progenitors-news.description: Mouse lineage tracing and human stem cell differentiation suggest two neuroectodermal pathways. The original figures connect gene expression maps, fate restriction, relative expression, and cell proportions to follow-up experiments.

2026-09-19-phosphate-molecular-walker-ne.title: A Fuel-Driven Phosphate Molecular Walker
2026-09-19-phosphate-molecular-walker-ne.description: A cyclic phosphate intermediate opens selectively to move the walker to its next foothold. The reaction diagrams and steady-state data explain fuel supply, mass balance, the denominator behind 16% efficiency, and the limits imposed by strongly acidic conditions.

2026-09-20-claude-biomolecular-optimizat.title: How Claude sped up biomolecular models
2026-09-20-claude-biomolecular-optimizat.description: Anthropic’s figures trace changes in execution mode, kernels, memory use and numerical accuracy. What do average speedups tell us about large inputs, eight-GPU runs and occasional structural failure?

2026-09-20-developmental-xenocortication.title: Giving human cortical organoids room to grow
2026-09-20-developmental-xenocortication.description: Figures from a developmental xenocortication study trace graft growth, cell composition, calcium imaging and behavior. What does the reported 91.9% of cortical volume measure, and how did the host environment shape the results?

2026-09-22-irf4-treg-stability-news.title: What keeps regulatory T cells stable during inflammation?
2026-09-22-irf4-treg-stability-news.description: A study of a distant regulatory region of IRF4 links chromatin, regulatory T-cell stability, suppressive function and mouse results. The figures show which outcome fell by 85%.

2026-09-22-personalized-phage-guideline-.title: How can personalized phage therapy be evaluated?
2026-09-22-personalized-phage-guideline-.description: An international consensus guideline connects phage selection, quality, administration and follow-up. Its tables distinguish recommendation strength from agreement among experts and identify gaps in clinical evidence.

2026-09-23-herbot-her2-biliary-cancer-ne.title: Four drugs for HER2-positive biliary tract cancer: reading a 55% response rate
2026-09-23-herbot-her2-biliary-cancer-ne.description: The single-arm phase 1b/2 HERBOT study enrolled 40 patients who received trastuzumab, nivolumab, gemcitabine and cisplatin. The figures explain objective response and Kaplan–Meier estimates in a study without a control group.

2026-09-23-nioh2-electrochemical-dac-new.title: Capturing CO₂ from air with a battery-like cell
2026-09-23-nioh2-electrochemical-dac-new.description: A symmetric Ni(OH)₂ cell uses a pH difference to capture and release CO₂. The equations put 0.17 V and 0.83 MWh per tonne of CO₂ in context and distinguish the 5,000-hour and 48-hour tests.

2026-09-28-high-voltage-linio2-nanorod-n.title: LiNiO₂ nanorods that reverse the H3 phase transition
2026-09-28-high-voltage-linio2-nanorod-n.description: High-voltage cycling can damage nickel-rich cathodes. This study explores structural reversibility, explains the 4.95 V and 100-cycle tests and identifies what remains to be shown in a commercial full cell.

2026-09-28-spacey-spatial-omics-gnn-news.title: How SpaCEy finds tissue patterns linked to prognosis
2026-09-28-spacey-spatial-omics-gnn-news.description: An explainable graph neural network searches for prognostic motifs in spatial relationships between cells. Small examples explain graphs, AUC and the concordance index, and show the limits of causal interpretation.

2026-09-28-variation-tolerant-implant-wp.title: Wireless power for a soft implant as the body moves
2026-09-28-variation-tolerant-implant-wp.description: A wearable transmitter pairs automatic resonance tracking with a liquid-metal receiver. The study identifies which stages the 50% transfer efficiency and the 0.4 W to 24 mW measurements describe, along with the limits of its 60 mm coil and animal tests.

2026-09-29-agent-thermostable-mrna-vacci.title: Can an AI-selected formulation help an mRNA vaccine withstand heat?
2026-09-29-agent-thermostable-mrna-vacci.description: In a preclinical study, AGENT selected follow-up experiments to improve thermal stability. The article distinguishes luminescence, antibody measurements and protection, and explains the role of Gaussian processes and expected improvement.

2026-09-29-lc1-large-rna-delivery-news.title: LC-1 nanoparticles carry large RNA cargoes
2026-09-29-lc1-large-rna-delivery-news.description: A mouse study tested lipid nanoparticles for delivering large gene-editor mRNAs. The article introduces mRNA delivery and explains how to interpret the reported cargo size, tissue-specific results and limits of the public data.

2026-09-29-silicon-solid-polymer-battery.title: How much did a silicon battery swell, and what does 337 Wh/kg measure?
2026-09-29-silicon-solid-polymer-battery.description: A cell combines a silicon–zinc–carbon anode with a polymer electrolyte. A beginner’s introduction leads into interface resistance, cycle life and the mass used to calculate the reported energy density.

2026-09-30-wrn-inhibitor-phase1-news.title: Targeting a DNA repair vulnerability in cancer: the phase 1 WRN inhibitor trial
2026-09-30-wrn-inhibitor-phase1-news.description: The first clinical study of an oral inhibitor targeting WRN dependence in MSI cancers reports 74.2% disease control and 10.6% tumor shrinkage. The patient flow and efficacy figures explain the difference, adverse events and limits of the study.

2026-10-04-nutrivax-measles-uptake-news.title: Bundling nutrition support with vaccination raised measles vaccine uptake
2026-10-04-nutrivax-measles-uptake-news.description: A cluster-randomized trial in Nigeria measured the change in vaccination uptake when services were bundled. The outcome was service use rather than vaccine efficacy.

2026-10-04-ultrahigh-voltage-li-metal-po.title: A 628 Wh/kg lithium-metal pouch cell: what mass is in the denominator?
2026-10-04-ultrahigh-voltage-li-metal-po.description: A study of the LiDPFP additive reports cell energy density and lifetime. The article relates both results to cell mass, voltage, charge and discharge rates, and temperature.

2026-10-05-avian-r2-targeted-integration.title: Targeted gene insertion with avian R2: what does the reported success rate measure?
2026-10-05-avian-r2-targeted-integration.description: A study reports insertion rates of up to 60% in its abstract. The article examines the unclear measurement denominator and the evidence still needed for long-term expression and safety.

2026-10-06-shotgun-mammalian-metabolic-e.title: Exploring different metabolic pathways across mammalian cells
2026-10-06-shotgun-mammalian-metabolic-e.description: An SGE study investigates combinations of small genetic units. The article compares simulated combinatorial diversity with growth observed in the cells researchers selected.

2026-10-06-visionary-ai-preeclampsia-new.title: Can retinal blood vessels help predict preeclampsia?
2026-10-06-visionary-ai-preeclampsia-new.description: Visionary AI uses retinal vessels to estimate risk. The article examines the study population, the two models, preprocessing in external validation and the influence of disease prevalence on predictive values.

2026-10-07-horizontal-up-microfluidic-ch.title: Cooling a chip with a dielectric fluid at a critical heat flux of 1,570 W/cm²
2026-10-07-horizontal-up-microfluidic-ch.description: An embedded two-phase microfluidic cooler combines horizontal liquid inflow with vertical vapor removal. Its dielectric working fluid reached a critical heat flux of 1,570 W/cm².

2026-10-10-endometriosis-spatial-neuroim.title: Mapping cells in endometriosis lesions: what can the map tell us about pain?
2026-10-10-endometriosis-spatial-neuroim.description: Researchers mapped cell positions in human tissue and measured responses in cell co-cultures. Direct patient pain measurements and treatment effects were outside the study’s scope.

2026-10-10-neural-crest-nuclear-confinem.title: How does a cell nucleus survive a tight squeeze?
2026-10-10-neural-crest-nuclear-confinem.description: Zebrafish neural crest cells deform as they move through confined tissue. The study tracks Lamin B2 and DNA damage and sets limits on extrapolation to adult humans or cancer treatment.

2026-10-14-iot-ai-self-replication-news.title: AI self-replication on IoT devices: what did the report test?
2026-10-14-iot-ai-self-replication-news.description: Anthropic evaluated distributed inference and replication in an emulator as separate tasks. The report did not demonstrate an autonomous worm spreading on real devices.

2026-10-16-computational-metalloprotease.title: AI-designed zinc enzymes that cut proteins
2026-10-16-computational-metalloprotease.description: A Nature study reports designed metalloproteases that cleave a specified peptide bond. The article examines the experimental result, slow catalysis and limits of therapeutic claims.

2026-10-17-autonomous-wet-lab-verid-news.title: An autonomous lab learns from its digital twin
2026-10-17-autonomous-wet-lab-verid-news.description: Google Research combined lab-state tracking, simulation and execution logs to identify liquid-handling errors and correct experiments in an early demonstration.

2026-10-18-ferroptosis-self-organization.title: How cell arrangement shapes waves of ferroptosis
2026-10-18-ferroptosis-self-organization.description: A Cell study examines how density, alignment, YAP and NRF2 signaling, and lipid polarity influence where oxidative cell death spreads and stops.

clinical-llm-validation-framework.title: Validating clinical LLMs across 920,000 notes
clinical-llm-validation-framework.description: Rules, grounding checks, independent judgments, expert samples and clinical outcomes helped validate information extraction without a complete answer key. External validation remains open.

leash-agent-escalation.title: When should a smaller agent call a stronger model?
leash-agent-escalation.description: LEASH uses uncertainty in hidden states to escalate selected computer-use tasks. The preprint compares cost and success on OSWorld and identifies gaps in validation.

oncology-consultation-ai.title: Can AI reduce the work of preparing for a first oncology visit?
oncology-consultation-ai.description: A before-and-after study with nine clinicians and 33 consultations reported less work and time spent. The small sample, lack of a control group and industry interests limit interpretation.

airscope-wireless-cortex-imaging.title: A 1 g wireless microscope images the cortex of freely moving mice
airscope-wireless-cortex-imaging.description: Airscope’s quoted mass excludes the battery. The article examines its field of view, wireless transmission and the checks used to validate cortical signals.

miopm-multi-immersion-light-sheet.title: The miOPM light-sheet microscope with interchangeable objectives
miopm-multi-immersion-light-sheet.description: One optical system accepts oil, water and air objectives and maintains diffraction-limited performance across refractive indices from 1.33 to 1.51. Alignment remains a practical constraint.

multi-ancestry-breast-cancer-gwas.title: A GWAS of 1.9 million people expands the breast cancer risk map
multi-ancestry-breast-cancer-gwas.description: A meta-analysis of African, Asian and European ancestry populations reported 415 risk loci. The article examines statistical power, unequal representation and clinical validation.

nexus-ai-tb-screening.title: Tuberculosis screening with AI in the field
nexus-ai-tb-screening.description: A deployment announcement from Google and Nexus AI describes X-ray screening, confirmatory testing, processing time, rollout by country and regulatory scope.

sequential-diagnosis-benchmark.title: What should a diagnostic AI ask next?
sequential-diagnosis-benchmark.description: A Science study asks models to choose questions and tests in sequence. Its reported 83.2% accuracy raises specific questions for clinical validation.

2027-01-15-2027-01-15.title: Building a personal AI environment
2027-01-15-2027-01-15.description: Practical notes on configuring a personal AI development environment and its architecture.
